title: setaria viridis subvar. linearis
intro: Setaria viridis subvar. linearis, commonly known as green foxtail or wild millet, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Setaria viridis subvar. linearis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
